harper: Hi! I accepted the org invite but when I try to push a release branch I get "remote: Permission to redwood/release-scripts.git denied to harper.personal". I thought I accepted with my work email. Who should I bug for team membership?

zoe: Welcome, Harper! Quick check: which GitHub account did you accept the invite with (work vs personal)? Also did you accept via the Desktop app or web? Desktop sometimes uses a cached personal login.

harper: I accepted from the GitHub Desktop app on my laptop. My work email is harper@redwood.ai but my Desktop was still signed into harper.personal@gmail account. I did enable 2FA on my work account and added SSH key there.

alec: Yep that explains it. GitHub Desktop will accept the invite using the logged-in account. If that was your personal account, the org treated it as an outside collaborator. I can either add your work handle to release-maintainers or we can revoke and resend the invite to your work handle. Which do you prefer?

harper: Temp add is fine, need to push a release branch to trigger our deploy pipeline. Also curious how to avoid this in future.

platform-bot: Onboarding note: harper (harper@redwood.ai) — detected invite accepted by different GH account (harper.personal). SSO: connected on work account; 2FA: enabled; SSH key: present. Flagging for platform team to reconcile.

alec: I granted write to redwood/release-scripts for harper@work for this branch and re-ran the team sync to map both aliases. Try this to push:
```bash
git checkout -b release/v1.2.3-fix
# make change
git add . && git commit -m "chore(release): bump version"
git push --set-upstream origin release/v1.2.3-fix
```

zoe: For verification later, run `gh auth status` and `gh api /user/teams --jq '.[] .name'` after you log in with your work account. If you ever see a 403 while ssh auth says you're authenticated, it's usually a team mapping or invite-account mismatch.

harper: Push worked and CI triggered. Thanks! Two small asks: (1) can we get a tiny line in the onboarding docs about Desktop/mobile accept caveats, and (2) can the invite email mention which GH account will be used if multiple are signed in?

onboard-bot: Logged suggestions ONB-600: add note about GitHub Desktop/mobile invite caveats and invite-account clarity.

alec: Filed INF-900 to make the team-sync tolerant of invite aliases and to detect Desktop/mobile acceptance; will follow up with a small fix to the invite copy. Leaving this thread once you confirm.

harper: Confirmed everything works. Closing, and thanks for the quick help! :tada:
